Package index

Core Functions

Primary functions for computing P_med and extracting mediation structures from fitted statistical models.

pmed()
Compute P_med: Probabilistic Effect Size for Mediation
pmed-formula
Compute P_med from Formula
pmed-MediationData
Compute P_med from MediationData
extract_mediation
Re-export extract_mediation from medfit

Modern estimands

Cross-fitted, influence-function-based estimators beyond the core P_med: the gauge residual (W = R/OE, with weak-identification gates), incremental P_med, the Sobol variance-scale and Wasserstein versions, and the scale-indexed rg-flow proportion mediated with cluster-robust inference.

ward_residual()
Gauge-Calibrated Proportion Mediated
incr_pmed()
Incremental Mediated Elasticity Curve
incr_sensitivity()
M–Y Confounding Sensitivity for the Incremental Mediated Elasticity
sobol_pmed()
Sobol / Variance-Scale Proportion Mediated
sobol_from_theta()
Map corner means to the Sobol variance decomposition
wasserstein_pmed()
Wasserstein / Transport-Scale Proportion Mediated
pmedW_dr()
Doubly-Robust Wasserstein Proportion Mediated
pmedW_md()
Multivariate Wasserstein Proportion Mediated
sinkhorn_div()
Debiased Sinkhorn Divergence
rg_flow_contrast()
Paired contrast of the proportion mediated between two scales
rg_coarse_grain()
Coarse-grain multilevel data to aggregation scale m
g_hat_eif()
Efficient-influence-function estimator of the scale-indexed proportion mediated

Sensitivity analysis

Unmeasured mediator-outcome confounding: tipping-point analysis shared across the estimands.

pmed_sensitivity()
M–Y Confounding Sensitivity for a Proportion-Mediated Estimand

Separation status of an extracted model's binary equations

Is a family Gaussian (NULL is treated as Gaussian)?

Data variables a model-matrix column label refers to

.mbco_gll()
Gaussian profile log-likelihood given SSE, variance V, and n rows.

Verified bounded-resolution LR inversion for single-mediator models

Maximized log-likelihood under the constraint a*b = ie0

Maximized log-likelihood under the constraint sum(a*b) = ie0 (parallel).

Maximized log-likelihood under the constraint P_med = pnorm(qstar).

Maximized log-likelihood under the constraint joint P_med = pnorm(qstar).
.mbco_ll_null()
Gaussian exact-null union likelihood
.mbco_lr_at()
Profile LR statistic for H0: P_med = p (single-mediator Gaussian MBCO)

One nloptr run in the optim() result shape

Convergence-checked nloptr minimizer with one deterministic fallback

Joint Gaussian log-likelihood for the parallel free model at given params.

Run Nelder-Mead from several starts, returning the best maximized log-likelihood (-min value), or NA if every start fails / is penalized.

Deterministic perturbed warm starts for the parallel MBCO optimizers.

Assemble a bootstrap PmedResult (shared by both parallel bootstraps).
.pmed_parallel_closed()
Closed-form joint P_med for parallel mediators (Gaussian).
.pmed_parallel_coef_names()
Names of the structural coefficients (a_j, b_j) in the parallel estimates vector / vcov. Uses the structural aliases a{j} / b{j}, which BOTH the lm/glm and lavaan medfit extractors expose (with full vcov rows) – unlike the source-specific m{j}_<tx> / y_<mediator_j> names, which exist only in the lm/glm extractor and would break the parametric bootstrap on a lavaan extract.
.pmed_parallel_mbco()
MBCO confidence interval for parallel joint P_med (Gaussian).
.pmed_parallel_nonparametric_boot()
Nonparametric bootstrap for parallel joint P_med.
.pmed_parallel_parametric_boot()
Parametric bootstrap for parallel joint P_med.
.pmed_parallel_plugin()
Plugin (point estimate only) for parallel joint P_med.
.pmed_parallel_require_gaussian()
Require a Gaussian parallel extract (finite residual SDs present).
.pmed_parametric_boot()
Parametric Bootstrap for P_med
.pmed_plugin()
Plugin Estimator (Point Estimate Only)
